PORT.description: HTTP listen port. Databasus default is 4005.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Optional. If set with DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD (Dockerfile bootstrap), creates this admin on first boot. Leave empty to use UI Sign up.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Admin password for Dockerfile bootstrap (min 8 chars). Leave empty to skip bootstrap.

DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: Optional. When bootstrap runs, close open registration (default true). Set false to leave sign-up open.

IS_DISABLE_ANONYMOUS_TELEMETRY.description: Optional. Disable anonymous usage telemetry (default true). Upstream default is false.

DATABASUS_URL.description: Optional. Public base URL used in email links.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Railway Bucket S3 endpoint. Paste into Databasus → Storages → S3.

S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket name for backup archives.
